notes: חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵה is one unit for the single word 'fifteen'; neither morpheme carries content the other lacks, so rule 23 heads it on the morpheme standing first.

Both demonstrative phrases give the written 'this' to the pronoun and leave the noun's article and the agreement article unrepresented under rule 41; עַל before the second is unrepresented because the ASV writes 'defend this city' with a bare object.
